reason: Researched each of the four legs individually (WebSearch budget was exhausted this session, so all research below used WebFetch against stockanalysis.com, investing.com, and yahoo finance) and none shows broken momentum versus the group, which is the book's own explicit cut trigger. XLE (28%, energy): still the best-performing sector ETF of the recent stretch (+7.4% in August per State Street data), refining margins at record levels, diesel supply tight through winter, top holding XOM near highs; leg is +0.44% since the 2026-09-16 entry, best of the four, though WTI spot is down ~4% over the past month on demand-concern headlines out of Europe/China -- that is a spot-crude wobble, not yet an equity-momentum break, since XLE itself has not rolled over. IWD (20%, broad value): narrative is a broadening rally with value participating alongside growth, +26.5% trailing 1yr, no reversal signals found. XLF (10%, financials): 'breakout' rally language, rising-rate tailwind, strong bank earnings/dealmaking; the -0.13% leg mark is noise (3 trading days old, inside a tight range) not a momentum break. XLV (8%, healthcare): actively described as the rotation destination for money leaving tech, FDA leadership turnover seen as bullish for rare-disease/biotech bets, multiple pharma names at all-time highs -- this is the strongest qualitative story of the four. All four legs are 3 trading days into the current leg (entered 2026-09-16), sit comfortably inside their stops (-8% to -10%) and well short of take-profits, and none is underperforming the group badly enough to justify a cut under the book's stated methodology. A full replacement here would pay real bps in equities friction to re-express a thesis that the research confirms is still intact, and 3 days is too short a window to distinguish genuine momentum decay from ordinary chop. The only mildly bearish datapoint (WTI down on demand fears) argues for watching XLE closely next week, not for cutting it today -- the 34% cash buffer already provides ample macro-shock protection while that plays out. Holding preserves the intact thesis and avoids paying churn costs on a book that has not generated a valid signal to act on.
